description: Header file defining the QuicPacketCreator class responsible for creating and serializing QUIC packets, including interfaces for delegate callbacks, packet management, and frame handling within the QUIC core implementation.

classes.name: QuicPacketCreator
classes.description: Main class responsible for creating, serializing, and managing QUIC packets, including frame addition, padding, and packet serialization logic.

classes.name: QuicPacketCreator::DelegateInterface
classes.description: Interface for delegate callbacks related to packet buffer management, serialization, error handling, and packet generation decisions.

classes.name: QuicPacketCreator::DebugDelegate
classes.description: Interface for debug callbacks when frames are added or coalesced into packets.

classes.name: QuicPacketCreator::ScopedPeerAddressContext
classes.description: RAII class to temporarily set peer address and connection IDs during packet creation scope.

classes.name: QuicPacketCreator::NoPacket
classes.description: Static method returning a dummy, valid but empty SerializedPacket.

classes.name: QuicPacketCreator::ScopedSerializationFailureHandler
classes.description: Helper class to handle serialization failure scope, clearing queued frames and reporting errors.

methods.name: StopSendingVersion
methods.description: Prevents the framer from serializing the protocol version in sent packets.

methods.name: SetDiversificationNonce
methods.description: Sets the nonce to be sent in packets encrypted at the initial encryption level.

methods.name: UpdatePacketNumberLength
methods.description: Updates the packet number length for future packets based on peer state.

methods.name: SkipNPacketNumbers
methods.description: Skips a specified number of packet numbers.

methods.name: StreamFramePacketOverhead
methods.description: Calculates overhead for a packet with one stream frame given various parameters.

methods.name: ConsumeDataToFillCurrentPacket
methods.description: Adds stream data to the current packet if space permits, or flushes if full.

methods.name: ConsumeCryptoDataToFillCurrentPacket
methods.description: Creates a crypto frame fitting into the current packet.

methods.name: HasRoomForStreamFrame
methods.description: Checks if a stream frame can fit into the current packet.

methods.name: HasRoomForMessageFrame
methods.description: Checks if a message frame of given size can fit into the current packet.

methods.name: FlushCurrentPacket
methods.description: Serializes all queued frames into a packet and processes it.

methods.name: CreateAndSerializeStreamFrame
methods.description: Creates and serializes a stream frame, returning number of bytes consumed.

methods.name: HasPendingFrames
methods.description: Checks if there are frames pending serialization.

methods.name: GetPendingFramesInfo
methods.description: Returns a string describing pending frames (debug utility).

methods.name: HasPendingRetransmittableFrames
methods.description: Checks if retransmittable frames are pending.

methods.name: HasPendingStreamFramesOfStream
methods.description: Checks if stream frames for a specific stream are pending.

methods.name: BytesFree
methods.description: Returns available bytes for additional frames in current packet.

methods.name: BytesFreeForPadding
methods.description: Returns available space for padding frames.

methods.name: ExpansionOnNewFrame
methods.description: Returns expected size expansion when adding a new frame.

methods.name: PacketSize
methods.description: Returns current serialized size of the packet.

methods.name: AddFrame
methods.description: Attempts to add a frame to the packet; flushes if it doesn't fit.

methods.name: AddPaddedSavedFrame
methods.description: Adds a frame with padding, allowing padding frames.

methods.name: SerializeConnectivityProbingPacket
methods.description: Creates a connectivity probing packet for pre-v99 versions.

methods.name: SerializePathChallengeConnectivityProbingPacket
methods.description: Creates a PATH CHALLENGE probing packet with padding.

methods.name: SerializePathResponseConnectivityProbingPacket
methods.description: Creates a PATH RESPONSE probing packet with optional padding.

methods.name: AddPathResponseFrame
methods.description: Adds a PATH RESPONSE frame to current packet.

methods.name: AddPathChallengeFrame
methods.description: Adds a PATH CHALLENGE frame to current packet.

methods.name: SerializeCoalescedPacket
methods.description: Serializes a coalesced packet into buffer.

methods.name: HasSoftMaxPacketLength
methods.description: Checks if a soft max packet length is set.

methods.name: SetDefaultPeerAddress
methods.description: Sets the default peer address for outgoing packets.

methods.name: HasRetryToken
methods.description: Checks if a retry token is set.

methods.name: NextSendingPacketNumber
methods.description: Returns the packet number for the next packet to be sent.
